send: date -Is; hostname   # this machine: the exe.dev VM
hostname; date '+%F %T %Z'; echo "S=$S"   # every node command below is its own Slurm step on sdfmilan048: $S <script>
git rev-parse HEAD; git log -1 --format='%s' | cut -c1-138; echo "local changes: $(git status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
git diff --stat 8830147da HEAD | tail -1; git diff --stat 8830147da HEAD -- psdaq/psdaq/configdb | cut -c1-138
# Step 2 at this HEAD. Build (one srun step), then the sim unit tests (one srun step)
export P=$B/rec; mkdir -p $P/ev; echo "records in $P/ev: $(ls -A $P/ev | wc -l); work dirs in $P: $(ls -d $P/wd-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
# Each type on a fresh DAQ in its own srun step: up --det <type> --detach, cycle --events 1000, its DRP log lines, xtc2_check (as written: PASS; --self-test-offset 1: must FAIL), down
# opal (this PR): its own opal_config on the emulated KCU, FEB and camera; the camera's serial (UART) answers come from the seed files:
python3 -c "import json; [print(t, json.load(open(f'psdaq/psdaq/sim/seeds/{t}.json'))['_uart']['replies']) for t in ('opal', 'piranha4')]" | cut -c1-138
# piranha4 (this PR): its own piranha4_config; serial answers from seeds/piranha4.json (above)
# tb (this PR): its own tb_config, with this PR's two fixes (563b4711b: the import, and tb_connectionInfo takes the alloc message)
# epixquad (this PR): its own epixquad_config with the import-order fix (6baccd060); the sim config DB adds user.pixel_map as zeros:
# ts (PR #36, regression): xpmdet_config, ts_connect and ts_config on simxpm
# daq_sim coverage at this HEAD over the records of these runs (bound evidence: each record proves a row only if its files show it ran)
# the same check with the tb record removed: the tb row must fail, named, exit 1
# the hardware path (no sim:// device), every type, from base wt-cov (2d9593bc5) and from this HEAD, each its own srun step; then diffed

TYPES='opal piranha4 tb epixquad fakecam cspad epixhremu jungfrauemu ts hrencoder epixm320 epix100 wave8 wave8he epixhr2x2 epixquad1kfps tt epixuhr3x2'; for w in wt-cov wt-types2; do $S $B/hwpath.sh $w $TYPES > $P/hw-$w.log 2>&1; head -1 $P/hw-$w.log; done
# only tb differs: at base tb_config dies at import (ModuleNotFoundError); at this HEAD tb_init gets to the device (no /dev/datadev_0 here)
for w in wt-cov wt-types2; do echo "## $w"; sed -n '/^-- tb python/,/^-- epixquad python/p' $P/hw-$w.log | head -12 | cut -c1-138; done
# Step 3: the three config-code defects this PR fixes, at the base 8830147da (worktree wt-base39, built there, unmodified), then the same at this HEAD
git -C $R/wt-base39 log -1 --format='base %H %s' | cut -c1-138; echo "base local changes: $(git -C $R/wt-base39 status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"
echo "checkout local changes: $(git status --short --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"; date '+%F %T %Z'; exit
